newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat closes higher on firm cash, exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat closes higher on firm cash, exports.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures closed higher on firm cash basis markets, an increase in exports and on follow-through technical buying from Monday's rally, traders said.
"They had gotten short and are covering, that's all it is," a trader said.
USDA's weekly export inspections report Monday was bullish to futures prices and traders also cited the lack of deliveries on the September as helping fuel gains.
There were some ideas deliveries on the September could be heavy but so far the delivery market has been nearly void.
A strong rally in soybean futures also boosted wheat, the traders said.
Wheat futures volume was estimated at 15,000 contracts, down from 16,496 Monday. Wheat options volume was estimated at 4,500 contracts, about the same as 4,537 Monday.
Wheat closed 3-3/4 to eight cents per bushel higher, with September up eight at $4.61-1/2 a bushel.
